case.selection: exact conserved archived membership SHA; no new group selection

control_A_boundary: conditional allocation independence given exact member totals and group S/R marginals; not iid causal or real-event model
control_B_boundary: paired count regrouping within floor(log2(total item support)) bands; no preservation of exact group S/R totals; not semantic quality or heldout utility
execution_receipt_policy: Independent local CPU analysis with dedicated command, actor, input/code/contract/output hashes and runtime receipt; axiomdesk_run training launcher not used because no training launcher/model/backend is invoked.
inference: six two-sided empirical comparisons of equal-group mean JSD against Control B; BH adjusted values across exactly six, without arbitrary-dependence FDR guarantee; BY(H6) reported as fixed dependency-conservative sensitivity; min attainable two-sided p 0.01
jsd_definition: base2 JSD between normalized search/rec observation allocations over members of the same SID group; distinct from provider-label divergence
maxrss_unit: bytes on macOS; KiB on Linux
primary_aggregation: equal weight per collision group; singleton groups excluded
public_safety: aggregate-only summary; full group/SID tables remain restricted
